security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown formatting, documentation links, or configuration examples rather than executable behavior. The self-hosted cache sample has a real security concern because it combines request-controlled file paths, unauthenticated artifact writes, and disabled signatures in copyable guidance.

remediation.issue: Self-hosted cache sample lacks safe path handling and authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Validate teamId and hash values, reject path separators, resolve paths under a fixed cache directory, and require authentication for all artifact routes.

remediation.issue: Remote cache signatures are disabled in the self-hosted example.
remediation.suggestion: Keep cache signatures enabled or add a clear warning that disabling signatures is only for local testing.

remediation.issue: Environment file examples could be misunderstood as secret handling guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Explain that env files should only affect cache invalidation and must never be uploaded, logged, or stored in cache artifacts.

semantic_findings.title: Insecure Self-Hosted Cache Example
semantic_findings.description: The Express cache sample builds storage paths from request values, accepts artifact uploads, and disables remote cache signatures. If copied into production, it could allow unauthorized cache reads, writes, or cache poisoning.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited sample directly combines request parameters with filesystem paths and shows signature disabled for the cache. The risk depends on whether users copy the example, but the guidance is security-relevant.

content.value_statement: Monorepo builds slow down when cache inputs, outputs, and CI filters are unclear. This skill provides Turborepo caching patterns for local builds, remote cache setup, and pipeline debugging.
actual_capabilities: Drafts turbo.json pipeline configurations with task dependencies, outputs, inputs, and environment variables.
Shows remote caching setup for Vercel and self-hosted cache workflows.
Provides CI examples for filtered Turborepo build and test runs.
Explains Turborepo filter syntax for package scoping and changed-package builds.
Lists debugging commands for dry runs, task graphs, summaries, and verbose cache output.
limitations: It does not inspect a repository unless the user provides access or file content.
Self-hosted cache examples need security hardening before production use.
It does not replace Turborepo documentation for version-specific behavior.
It focuses on Node.js monorepos and may need adaptation for other ecosystems.

use_cases.title: Set Up A New Monorepo Cache
use_cases.description: Create baseline Turborepo tasks, outputs, inputs, and package scripts for a new workspace.

use_cases.title: Improve CI Build Times
use_cases.description: Apply remote caching, filtered builds, and dependency-aware test runs to reduce repeated CI work.

use_cases.title: Debug Cache Misses
use_cases.description: Use dry runs, summaries, graph output, and explicit inputs to find why tasks are not reused.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Basic Cache Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Turborepo workspace.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure Turborepo caching for a new monorepo with apps and shared packages. Include tasks, outputs, and basic verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Turbo Configuration
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of current cache settings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Turborepo configuration for cache correctness. Check task dependencies, outputs, inputs, persistent tasks, and environment variables.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize CI With Remote Cache
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CI workflow for Turborepo remote caching. Include filtered builds, changed package detection, secure secret handling, and cache validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Complex Cache Misses
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting across packages and environments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me debug repeated Turborepo cache misses across local and CI runs. Build a checklist for inputs, env values, outputs, package filters, and task dependencies.

output_examples.input: A user asks why Turborepo rebuilds every package in CI.
output: A likely-cause checklist covering filters, base branch references, task dependencies, and global inputs.
A set of CI changes that build only affected packages and their dependencies.
Verification steps using dry-run output and build summaries.

output_examples.input: A user wants to add remote caching to a Vercel-backed monorepo.
output: A setup sequence for login, project linking, team configuration, and CI variables.
A short security note about token storage and secret handling.
Commands and checks to confirm that remote cache hits occur.

output_examples.input: A user provides a turbo configuration with missing outputs.
output: A task-by-task review of cacheable outputs and non-cacheable tasks.
Suggested output patterns for builds, tests, linting, and type checks.
A reminder to exclude framework-internal caches when needed.

best_practices: Define explicit outputs and inputs for every cacheable task.
Keep secrets out of cached artifacts, logs, and generated build outputs.
Use dry runs and summaries to verify cache behavior after each change.
anti_patterns: Do not cache long-running development servers as normal build tasks.
Do not disable remote cache signatures in production examples.
Do not use broad filters that skip required package dependencies.

faq.question: Does this skill run Turborepo commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. Command execution depends on the user and the active assistant environment.

faq.question: Can it configure remote caching?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains Vercel-backed remote caching and self-hosted cache patterns, with security review needed for custom servers.

faq.question: Can it help with cache misses?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests checks for inputs, outputs, environment variables, filters, task dependencies, and CI differences.

faq.question: Is it only for JavaScript monorepos?
faq.answer: It is written for Turborepo and Node.js workspaces. Other ecosystems may need different scripts and output paths.

faq.question: Does it handle secret management?
faq.answer: It gives basic warnings about secrets. Teams should use their CI provider and secret manager for production controls.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
